name: Portrait Station
blurb: Workshop tool, not a game region: the character-art QC booth in Ketch's garage — every painted portrait hung on a rust pegboard wall, graded by canvas readback (warm-key luminance band, faction-palette drift, silhouette readability, the real 64px dialogue-card crop), with side-by-side grading, faction-wall context hangs, a Vienot colour-vision pass and a paste-ready shot-list generator for re-sittings. Anchors and center live outside the playable map.
